values.note: Single site $20 a night, double site $40. Senior/Access pass halves the campsite fee on single sites only ($10).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Double Site: $40 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233911/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, double 40), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233911 (notice: 'No electricity, water or sewer site hookups at this facility') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground ('35 non-electric sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 35 non-electric sites in two loops, some on the lakeshore; host on site 12. recreation.gov's catalog has 34 (33 standard, 1 tent-only): max vehicle lengths 16-40 ft, six at 40 ft; one pull-through, the rest back-in.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground ('The campground has 35 non-electric sites for tent and camper trailer camping. Some sites are located on the lakeshore.') + RIDB catalog for 233911 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Four drinking-water spigots; boat ramp 2 miles away.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233911 ('Flush toilets and showers are located in both loops. No dump station is available.', 'a boat ramp 2 miles from the campground') + the Forest Service page ('There are 4 water spigots/hydrants for drinking water'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground ('Badin Lake Campground offers a year-round retreat') + recreation.gov 233911 overview (same wording; one rate season covering Jan 1-Dec 31), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the Forest Service's Uwharrie Ranger District (not a concession). Sites 17 and 19 are always first-come, paid on site (cash or check, within 30 minutes of choosing a site). Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground ('To reserve a campsite, visit rec.gov. First come first serve sites are also available for purchase in person on a limited basis.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233911 ('Campsites 17 and 19 are always non-reservable for first come/first serve campers', is_commercially_managed false), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Access/Senior pass discount on the campsite fee of single sites only; none on double sites.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233911 (notice: 'For Access or Senior Access Pass card holders, discounts only apply on the campsite fee on single sites ... No discount on double sites'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed $20 single site and no hookups; added 35 sites (rec.gov 34) to 40 ft with one pull-through, showers/flush toilets/water, no dump station, year-round, recreation.gov booking with 2 always-first-come sites, Senior/Access discount on single sites. Operator: Forest Service (Uwharrie RD). Active alerts: only the Uwharrie alcohol prohibition and prescribed-burn notice; no closure. AWH note kept. Not stated: booking window (left inherited).
flags: Website lists only recreation.gov; the Forest Service page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/badin-lake-campground could be added.
